240-574-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-4460-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1957-4050-7918--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3899-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3899-5631.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1429-4981-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

4067-5457-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4067-5457-7890.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

1263-2511-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2595-5641-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

2512-3588-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1537-1921-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Zealous Conscripts token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3574-4222-6627.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-4222-6627.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-6627.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

2843-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2843-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2438-3562-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

4091-4613-5329.easyPrerequisites:
You control a nontoken Merfolk that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Aphetto Alchemist exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4091-4613-5329.description:
Activate the nontoken Merfolk using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

3528-3976-4067.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3528-3976-4067.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3528-3976-4067.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

465-3742-4251-4885-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4885-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2777-5231-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Driver of the Dead in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
2777-5231-5326.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing The Master, adding {R}.
When The Master dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Repeat.

4487-5113-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1866-2882-3195-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Dromar's Attendant.
1866-2882-3195-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Dromar's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

244-1840-2544-2713.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}.
Activate Component Pouch's second ability by tapping it, causing you to roll a d20 and put at least one component counter on it.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, or by paying {W} due to False Dawn, untapping Component Pouch.
Activate Component Pouch's first ability by tapping it and removing a component counter from it, adding {W}{W} which can be spent as mana of any color due to False Dawn.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {W}, untapping Component Pouch.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite component counters on Component Pouch, you may forego steps 2 and 3 to get infinite colored mana.

3086-3556-4605-4681.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1167-2341-3094-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to it's other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's Warform's ability, targeting any other opponent.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Mishra's Warform's ability, targeting any other opponent.
Resolve all Mishra's Warform abilities, causing you to gain control of the targeted opponents during their next turns.
Repeat during each of your turns.

628-3723-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

411-4191.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus without paying its mana cost.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R}, returning it to your hand and adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.
